frontmatter.sidebar_description: Delete a search index and everything built for it.

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `deleteSearchIndexWorkflow`. It belongs to the `@medusajs/medusa/core-flows` package.

This workflow deletes a search index, dropping every physical index ever built
for it along with the versions and sync history behind them. The next migration
rebuilds it from scratch, starting at version 1.

steps.name: validateSearchIndexesExistStep
steps.description:
This step validates that each requested search index is registered. If an
index is missing, the step throws an error.

steps.name: deleteSearchIndexStep
steps.description:
This step deletes a search index: every physical index ever built for it is
dropped from its engine, along with the versions and sync history behind them.
There is no compensation — a dropped index can only be rebuilt.

steps.name: searchIndexDeleted
steps.description:
This hook is called after the index has been
deleted. You can use it to perform any custom actions.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index to delete.

types.name: SearchIndexDeleteResult
types.description: The result returned after an index is deleted.

children.name: index
children.description: The name of the index that was deleted.

children.name: deleted_versions
children.description:
How many of the index's versions were dropped. `0` when the index is
registered but was never migrated, so nothing was ever built for it.
